gallery.section.track.hint: Tidy up your tracked plugins and notes
gallery.own: Can't find what you're looking for? Write your own query and save it as a view.
preset.month.desc: Released since the 1st; the most downloaded first.
preset.month.why: For a monthly sweep, and to see the date functions at work.
preset.fast.desc: Listed in the last 2 months and already past 1K downloads.
preset.fast.why: New plugins adopted quickly; likely to last.
preset.gems.desc: 1K–10K downloads, updated this month and grown by 20% or more.
preset.gems.why: Good work in the shadow of the big plugins.
preset.awake.desc: Released this month after at least 6 months of silence (incubation).
preset.awake.why: Maintenance has restarted; a good moment to return to an old need.
preset.popular.desc: 50K+ downloads and updated in the last 14 days.
preset.popular.why: Important changes that reach many people.
preset.milestones.desc: Passed 10K downloads in the last 30 days, whatever they have now.
preset.milestones.why: Plugins proving themselves; write any other count you watch instead of 10k.
preset.active.desc: 1K+ downloads and 3+ updates in the last 30 days; the fastest growing first.
preset.active.why: Lively projects their developer is focused on right now.
preset.stale.desc: Installed in this vault and not updated for 1+ year; the oldest first.
preset.stale.why: A compatibility risk: look for an alternative or clean up the vault.
preset.totry.desc: Plugins you track but haven't installed in this vault.
preset.totry.why: Your personal try-out list, sorted by your rating.
preset.ungrouped.desc: Tracked plugins not in any group yet.
preset.unrated.desc: Plugins you track but haven't rated yet.
preset.unrated.why: Your review queue; the most downloaded first.
preset.sleeping.desc: On your list but no new release for 1+ year.
preset.sleeping.why: To check whether they're still worth following.

help.title: Help
help.step.explore.desc: Search All, or click a card on Home: each card is a query whose list opens with one click.
help.step.track.desc: Track a plugin (☆): when it releases a new version, it shows on Home until you review it.
help.step.query.desc: For example: gain(30d) >= 500 AND NOT tracked. Save it as a view and it settles on Home as a widget.
home.quickstart.desc: Explore → Track → Write a query: three basic steps, one click each.
help.group.flags.hint: (written alone; NOT in front for the opposite)

help.op.bool: and (a space works too) / or / not
help.op.order: sort (desc: high to low, asc: low to high)
help.value.span: a span: days (d), weeks (w), months (m), years (y)
help.value.quoted: a value with spaces, or a plain text search
